en: A tinted panoramic view of a densely built city in a basin surrounded by low mountains, with a distinct conical hill rising in the center background. The foreground shows rocky terrain and lower houses, while the mid‑ground is filled with closely packed neoclassical-style buildings. The scene has a vintage, hand‑colored look. A website watermark, "www.elia.org.gr", appears in the lower right.
